mechanism_narrative: A downward trend in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trend is downward but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of such periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0 but 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of such periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and rise in unemployment indicate a weakening consumer demand and labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls and UNRATE rises but 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods, or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown indicated by industrial production growth below 0.5% monthly signals reduced economic output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO monthly growth < 0.5% but 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts signals strong consumer demand, which typically supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: HOUST trend is upward but 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% annually signals potential monetary tightening, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL annual rate > 2.5% but 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in retail sales and rise in the federal funds rate signal weak consumer demand and tightening monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with weak consumer demand
failure_condition: RSAFS falls and FEDFUNDS rises but 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of such periods, or the interaction term has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market recovery indicated by payroll employment growth above 0.5% monthly typically supports economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly but 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
